title_seed: 長報告可能只剩短報告
central_problem: canonicalization 刪掉 unsupported content 後，剩下的證據真的足以支撐原本要求的長度嗎？
reader_takeaway: 報告長度應受 unique supported content 約束，不應用 filler 補足。

known_at_the_time.fact: frozen offline audit 將 raw content 經 validation、repair、trace reconstruction 到 canonicalization 的 stage loss 分開記錄。
該 evidence 僅支援較短的 Limited Evidence Brief，而非要求的長報告。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: body/conclusion closure、supported-content feasibility 與 evidence-bearing quality gates 被用於阻止無根據擴寫。

not_yet_available.fact: 這是 frozen/offline acceptance，不是 live Writer 或 current generalization acceptance。

observed_failures.symptom: canonical supported content was much shorter than the requested long report
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: unsupported or unrealized prose was removed and the central answer/conclusion closure was incomplete
observed_failures.what_was_known_then: 短而可辯護比長而未支撐安全
observed_failures.later_resolution: later publication remained case-scoped and generalization tests kept export closed when support was insufficient

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: The frozen offline audit measured 2,214 canonical CJK characters and supported a shorter limited brief.
tests_and_metrics.result: offline/frozen metric; not a live publication guarantee

engineering_decisions.decision: 不以重複 paraphrase、泛化句或 padding 補足字數；降級成 limited brief。

architecture_state.state: supported facts/claims → realization audit → canonical body/conclusion → limited/formal decision

safe_numbers.value: 2,214 canonical CJK in the frozen audit
safe_numbers.meaning: offline run metric; use only with frozen/offline label

safe_public_facts.fact: 當證據只支持短報告時，系統應該縮短報告，而不是用語言把證據缺口藏起來。

retrospective_notes.note: 後來的 live generalization 會反覆證明這個 principle；本 packet 不把 offline metric 當成 live result。

source_refs.why_it_supports_this_fact: dated offline density and canonicalization audit

publication_risks: 不要把 2,214 或其他 gate number 脫離 run context。
